item.projecthero.tamaranean_starstone.to: A shard of Tamaran's sun, warm to the touch.
Right-click in daylight to become Starfire. Found in End City chests and meteor craters.
item.projecthero.starfire_suit.tooltip: Koriand'r's classic purple outfit. Anyone can wear it; it grants no powers.
message.projecthero.starfire.title: Starfire
message.projecthero.starfire.subtitle: Koriand'r of Tamaran
message.projecthero.starfire.acquired: The Starstone melts into sunlight. You are Starfire!
message.projecthero.starfire.acquired_hi: Double-tap Space to fly, R for starbolts. Joy makes you fly faster; Fury makes your starbolts hit harder. Hold Left-Alt for your moves, or read the Guidebook (DC).
message.projecthero.starfire.needs_sun: The Starstone stays cold. Hold it up under the open sky in daylight.
message.projecthero.starfire.no_starbolt: Not enough Starbolt. Stand in the sun to recharge.
message.projecthero.starfire.flight_out: Out of Starbolt: you drift down.
message.projecthero.starfire.kiss_none: Look at a villager or a player close by.
message.projecthero.starfire.kiss_villag: You learn their tongue! This villager now trades with you for less.
message.projecthero.starfire.kiss_gift: They are glad to see you and give you a gift.
message.projecthero.starfire.kiss_again: They smile. Come back tomorrow for another gift.
message.projecthero.starfire.kiss_player: You learn %s's language. You can see each other through walls for 60 s.
message.projecthero.starfire.kissed_by: %s learns your language. You can see each other through walls for 60 s.
hud.projecthero.starfire.title: Starfire
projecthero.starfire.ability.starbolt.de: A fast green bolt from alternating hands: 7 damage and a small blast (half to anyone else in it). Tap repeatedly to keep firing. 5 Starbolt.
Hold to charge a two-handed ball for up to 2 s, release to throw it: 10 to 28 damage in a 2 to 4 block blast. 25 Starbolt.
projecthero.starfire.ability.grab.desc: Grab a creature in reach and carry it, even in flight. Press again to hurl it along your look; the fall it takes counts. Not bosses. 15 Starbolt.
projecthero.starfire.ability.eye_beams.d: Hold for twin green beams from your eyes: 6 damage four times a second and sets targets on fire. Can clash with other beams. 8 Starbolt a second.
projecthero.starfire.ability.barrage.des: 12 starbolts spray in an arc over 1.5 s, each bending a little toward the nearest foe. 35 Starbolt, 6 s cooldown.
projecthero.starfire.ability.supernova.d: Only at full Fury. Rise and charge for 2 s, then explode like a sun: 45 damage to everything within 10 blocks, sets it on fire and blinds it. Your Fury turns into Joy. 100 Starbolt, 2 min cooldown.
projecthero.starfire.ability.flight.desc: Double-tap Space to take off and to land. Joy makes you up to 40% faster and the flight cheaper; Fury makes it heavier. About 1 Starbolt a second.
projecthero.starfire.ability.star_dash.d: Burst 10 blocks along your look in a green streak, in the air or on the ground. Nothing can hurt you for a moment. 10 Starbolt, 1 s cooldown.
Rush along your look wrapped in green fire (from the ground you launch up first) and crash down: 18 damage and a heavy knockback around you. 20 Starbolt.
projecthero.starfire.ability.charge.desc: Fly-tackle 8 blocks forward: the first creature you hit takes 8 and is carried along, and takes 10 more if you slam it into a wall. 20 Starbolt.
projecthero.starfire.ability.ground_poun: A double-fist slam (from the air you dive down first): 12 damage within 5 blocks and everything is thrown up. 25 Starbolt.
projecthero.starfire.ability.kiss.desc: Touch a villager to learn their tongue: better trades with that villager and a gift once a day. Touch a player: you see each other through walls for 60 s.
projecthero.starfire.ability.radiance.de: Toggle: your body lights up the area around you and Joy builds twice as fast, but bolts cost 25% more.
projecthero.guide.starfire.body: Koriand'r of Tamaran: a princess from another world who flies on joy, drinks in sunlight and fires green starbolts powered by her feelings. Becoming Starfire replaces whatever Primary power you held. It never changes your skin: your eyes glow green, your fists glow when a starbolt is ready, and your hair flicks into flames while you fly.
projecthero.guide.starfire.getting.body: Find a Tamaranean Starstone. It turns up in End City chests, in the chests of Meteor Impact sites, and sometimes lies at the bottom of a falling meteor's crater next to the pod. Right-click it in daylight under the open sky. Random serums never give it.
projecthero.guide.starfire.traits.body: 30 health, +6 melee damage and punches that knock creatures back, 20% less damage from every hit and no fall damage. She survives space: no drowning, no suffocating in the Galactus orbit and no freezing.
projecthero.guide.starfire.starbolt.body: Every move and the flight spend Starbolt (0 to 100). It refills from the sun: 9 a second in direct sunlight, 3 in shade or rain, slowly at night and slowest underground or in the Nether and End.
projecthero.guide.starfire.mood.body: The gauge has one needle between Joy (left) and Fury (right). Joy builds while you fly, stand in the sun, eat and stay near squadmates; it makes your flight up to 40% faster and cheaper. Fury builds when you are hurt or a squadmate within 16 blocks is hurt; it makes starbolts, Star Burst and the Barrage hit up to 60% harder but your flight heavier. At full Fury your eyes blaze and Supernova unlocks. The needle slowly drifts back to the middle.
projecthero.guide.starfire.flight.body: Double-tap Space in the air to take off, and again to land (touching the ground also lands you). It uses the shared directional flight: W flies along your look, Sprint goes faster, and with no keys you hover.
projecthero.guide.starfire.costume.body: Her classic purple outfit can be crafted and worn by anyone: the Starfire Top (purple wool, an emerald and iron), the Starfire Skirt and the Starfire Boots. Iron-level protection, no powers of its own.
projecthero.guide.starfire.commands.body: Operators: /projecthero power tune starfire starbolt <0-100>, mood <-100 to 100> (-100 full Joy, 100 full Fury), cooldowns.
